turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided that, and when?
I asked you a question, Hale. Who entered that zero, and before or after anyone called me?
I know your family has a history with academic integrity at this school. Claire's case.

Choose your next sentence very carefully, Hale. My daughter won her appeal, and you just told me this school walked in here thinking about her instead of Owen's essay. That goes in my notes, and it goes to the principal today.
Maybe this runs in the family.

Neither of my children lies, Hale, and you've just accused both of them without showing me one piece of paper. I'm writing down "runs in the family," word for word. Withdraw the zero, or we finish this conversation in the principal's office.
